root_cause.signature: Playwright Sync API inside the asyncio loop
root_cause.explanation: The V2.8.11 runner opened one outer sync_playwright() context and then called v284_candidate_collector.collect(), which itself opens sync_playwright(). The nested Sync API context blocked every window before candidate collection.

allowed: Remove the outer Playwright context around candidate collection.
Let v284_candidate_collector.collect() own its existing Playwright request context.
Open a separate non-nested Playwright request context only after candidate collection for selected PDF downloads.
Write retry outputs under a RETRY1 namespace while retaining the original technically-blocked evidence immutably.
forbidden: No changes to the eight frozen windows.
No changes to triage or classifier semantics.
No changes to six-per-window or forty-eight-total caps.
No changes to temporal provenance rules.
No changes to technical or density gates.
No price/return access and no fold3/fold4 access.
